export_evidence: ImportKey page for slug 'internet-data-services-india-private-limited' returned only the generic template shell: 'Shipments available for INTERNET DATA SERVICES INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, refreshed daily' — zero actual shipment rows rendered (0 rows seen vs. a page that advertises records). No bill-of-lading number, no date, no destination and no HS code was visible anywhere on the page.
note: No shipment evidence found in either direction, and no evidence of any kind could be retrieved. Source counter: 1 ImportKey page fetched (0 shipment rows actually seen); Volza, Eximpedia, Trademo and TheCompanyCheck all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; DuckDuckGo/searx search was unavailable (connection refused / timeouts), so no second source could be checked. The declared HS 997331 is a services code (IT/telecom-related services), which is not a goods code and would not normally appear in customs bill-of-lading data at all — so absence of B-L records is expected for a services entity and is NOT evidence of wrongdoing. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender participation and annual-report splits could not be retrieved: null, not public via the sources reachable here. Per Rule 5 the honest verdict is 'следов поставок не найдено' — no trace of supplies found, neither export nor domestic. This is a research-coverage gap, not a negative finding about the company; no rejection basis exists under Rules 1-3 (no evidence of non-existence, liquidation or bankruptcy was sought or found). Recommend re-running with working search access and a GSTIN lookup before any verdict.
